About this page

What the apps of one environment offer each other: every web app's API and every event an app publishes, with what its own repository says about it (its OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents, read for the image it runs). One card per app: its heading says what it uses in turn, and apps that only use are listed last. Open a row for its routes or its payload's fields and an example, and for who uses it. Open connection PR opens a pull request that lets the app you choose call the API or receive the event; you review and merge it on GitHub.
